en.sayed-ali-raza: and remain steady on it; offer prayer as much as possible and seek nearness (of Allāh) through it
, because it is, (imposed) upon the believers as (a) timed ordinance (Qur’ān, 4:103).
Have you not heard the reply of the people of Hell when they were asked
: What hath brought you into the hell? They shall say: We were not of those who offered the regular prayers (to Allāh)! (Qur’ān, 74:42-43).
